svg.title: Test user and emergency access accounts in one Entra tenant
svg.desc: In one Microsoft Entra tenant, in two rows. Row 1: the standard test user testuser1 is a member of the security group TestUsers. Row 2: two cloud-only emergency access accounts with the Global Administrator role are members of the security group EmergencyAccess. Your admin account is in neither group. EmergencyAccess is excluded from the sign-in rule you build in the Conditional Access lab.
